title: Demo scheduling — calendar invite showing wrong time (floating TZ)
text:
Demo scheduling — calendar invite showing wrong time (floating TZ)

["From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@stellarsystems.com>\\nTo: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>\\nCc: Stellar Systems Sales <sales@stellarsystems.com>\\nDate: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 23:12:00 +09:00\\nSubject: Request: Redwood demo — APAC/EU cross-region scheduling\\n\\nHi Karthik,\\n\\nThanks for the quick reply earlier. We're excited to see Redwood's inference platform. Our team is distributed (Tokyo, Singapore, and London) — would be great to find a time that doesn't land too late for APAC.\\n\\nAvailable windows next week:\\n- Mon/Wed 10:00–12:00 JST (UTC+9)\\n- Tue/Thu 15:00–17:00 GMT (UTC+0)\\n\\nIf you can propose 2 options, I'll confirm with our engineering lead. Also please send a calendar invite (we use Google Calendar).\\n\\nThanks,\\nOlivia Chen\\nSenior IT Ops\\nStellar Systems\\n\\n--\\nAttachment: demo-preferences.pdf (pdf)\\n", "From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>\\nTo: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@stellarsystems.com>\\nCc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>\\nDate: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -08:00\\nSubject: Re: Request: Redwood demo — APAC/EU cross-region scheduling\\n\\nHi Olivia — thanks for the windows.\\n\\nTwo options that would work for our team:\\n1) Wed Dec 8, 10:30–11:15 JST (Wed 01:30–02:15 PST) — good for demo engineers + Q&A\\n2) Thu Dec 9, 16:00–16:45 GMT (Thu 08:00–08:45 PST) — better for product + solutions\\n\\nI'm looping in Marissa (customer success) and Ben (solutions engineer) to confirm who will drive the meeting and whether we should run a short agenda. I'll create the invite once we pick one.\\n\\nBest,\\nKarthik\\nAccount Executive, Redwood Inference\\n\\n--\\nAttachment: proposed-times.png (image)", "From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>\\nTo: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>\\nCc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>\\nDate: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -05:00\\nSubject: Re: Request: Redwood demo — APAC/EU cross-region scheduling\\n\\nKarthik / Ben — I can host the Wed slot (Dec 8, 10:30 JST). Ben, can you confirm you'll join for the technical walkthrough?\\n\\nAlso a quick FYI: when we send invites to mixed-timezone guests, Google sometimes sends 'floating' times if the invite is created without an explicit timezone. Please create the invite with the meeting timezone set to Asia/Tokyo to avoid the invite shifting for APAC recipients.\\n\\nAgenda (draft):\\n- 10m intro + use-case (Stellar)\\n- 25m demo: latency/cost controls + routing\\n- 10m Q&A + next steps\\n\\nMarissa\\nCustomer Success Manager\\nRedwood Inference\\n\\n", "From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@stellarsystems.com>\\nTo: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>\\nDate: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 23:20:00 +09:00\\nSubject: Fwd: Calendar invite — something odd\\n\\nKarthik — I just accepted the invite you sent but on my calendar it shows as Wed 10:30 AM local (JST) in one view and Wed 01:30 AM in another. Sending a screenshot — looks like the invite lost its timezone anchor when forwarded to a colleague in London.\\n\\nForwarded message: \\nFrom: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>\\nTo: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@stellarsystems.com>\\nDate: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -08:00\\nSubject: Redwood demo — Wed Dec 8 10:30 JST (invite)\\n\\nHi Olivia — I've attached the invite (demo-invite.ics). Please confirm.\\n\\n--\\nAttachment: demo-invite.ics (calendar invite)\\nAttachment: cal-screenshot.png (png of calendar views)\\n", 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>\\nTo: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@stellarsystems.com>\\nCc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>\\nDate: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -08:00\\nSubject: Re: Fwd: Calendar invite — something odd\\n\\nHi Olivia — sorry about the confusion. I recreated the invite and explicitly set the event timezone to Asia/Tokyo (UTC+9) and re-sent the .ics. A few notes to avoid this in future:\\n\\n- When forwarding Google invites, some clients (and older versions of Outlook) convert events to \'floating\' if the TZ isn\'t embedded.\\n- Best practice: set the event timezone when creating the event, and include the UTC offset in the title (e.g., \\"Dec 8, 10:30 JST / 01:30 PST\\").\\n- If someone still sees the wrong time, ask them to re-import the attached .ics rather than relying on the forwarded live event.\\n\\nFinal: Wed Dec 8, 10:30–11:15 JST (Wed Dec 8, 01:30–02:15 PST). I\'ve also added the agenda and a dial-in link in the invite.\\n\\nThanks for flagging this — see you then.\\n\\nBest,\\nKarthik\\nAccount Executive, Redwood Inference\\n\\n--\\nRelated link: HubSpot: HS-8421\\nAttachment: demo-invite.ics (recreated)\\n']
